main_hypothesis: Group R54 candidates by the hard-decoded protected address of the child pointer and bound per-address beam occupancy before global backfill; this should reduce crowding and improve long-horizon trajectory survival/ranking without soft state mixing.
single_ablation: Identical R54 adaptive candidate generation and frozen scorer, but ordinary global top-32 pruning with no protected-address diversity allocation.
decision_rule: Confirm only if 8-hop answer regression vs ablation is no worse than 2pp and answer improves strictly at 64 or 128 hops.
